notes: Request a part straight from another tech. In Find a Part, press and hold any teammate's part for quick actions: Request transfer, Message, Call, Directions, or Copy #. A transfer request goes to the tech who has the part first — they confirm or deny that they have it — and once they confirm, it's sent to the office to make the move. A new "Part requests" card on your home screen shows any requests waiting on you, and the tech who asked sees the status update live.
